# David Cuevas Designs

> Custom heavy-timber architecture studio based in Northeast St. Petersburg, FL (33702), led by Master Shipwright and Master Joiner David Cuevas. Specializing in hurricane-rated 8x8 Western Red Cedar pergolas, outdoor pavilions, and executive carports crafted with Japanese interlocking joinery and the proprietary Tri-Axis 45° Compound Lock System™.

## Entity Disambiguation
- **This Business:** David Cuevas Designs LLC (`https://davidcuevasdesigns.com`) — Custom heavy-timber carpentry, cedar pergolas, pavilions, and carports in **St. Petersburg, Florida** (Pinellas County & South Tampa).
- **Not Affiliated With:** Graphic/brand designer studios outside Florida sharing a similar personal name.

## Core Services & Engineering Specs
- **Custom 8x8 & 10x10 Western Red Cedar Pergolas** (Open Shade Grids & Louvered Options)
- **Estate Cedar Pavilions** (Covered Roofs, Tongue-and-Groove Ceilings, Integrated Lighting)
- **Executive Heavy-Timber Carports** (Historic District & HOA Compliant)
- **Proprietary Joinery:** Traditional Japanese mortise-and-tenon & Tri-Axis 45° Compound Lock System™ (zero exposed rust-prone brackets)
- **Hurricane Compliance:** Stamped PE wind-load engineering (160+ MPH), 3+ ft reinforced concrete pier footings, full Pinellas & Hillsborough permitting
- **Finish:** Marine-grade penetrating Teak Oil treatment for salt-air & UV durability
- **Investment Range:** Custom builds typically start at $19,000 – $42,000+ (pre-fabricated off-site; 1–2 day on-site installation)
